subject: DI04000171

body.en:
Definition

A microcontroller integrates a CPU,memory and control-oriented peripherals on one chip for embedded tasks;a microprocessor is primarily a processing device whose complete system generally uses additional resources.

Explanation,application and checks

  • Compare CPU,memory,I/O,timers,power,cost and intended workload rather than saying one is always faster.MCU smay also use external memory/sensors;modern MPU-based SoCsmay integrate many peripherals.
  • An 8051 can scan switches and control a display with little external logic;a desktop-class MPU typically runs a much larger software environment.Selection follows real-time needs,memory,power and interfaces.
8051 has an internal ADC?

Not in the classic baseline;use an external ADC such as ADC0804.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Microcontrollerમાં embedded task માટે CPU,memory તથા control peripherals એક chip પર હોય;microprocessor મુખ્યત્વે processing device છે,જેની complete system સામાન્ય રીતે વધારાના resources વાપરે છે.

સમજણ,ઉપયોગ તથા ચકાસણી

  • CPU,memory,I/O,timers,power,cost તથા workloadથી સરખાવો;એક હંમેશાં faster નથી.MCU પણ external memory/sensors વાપરે;modern MPU-based SoCમાં પણ peripherals હોઈ શકે.
  • 8051 ઓછી external logicથી switches/display સંભાળે;desktop-class MPU સામાન્ય રીતે મોટું software environment ચલાવે.Selection real-time need,memory,power/interface મુજબ થાય.
8051માં Internal ADC છે?

Classic baselineમાં નથી;ADC0804 જેવા external ADC લો.

body.en:
Definition

Microcontroller hierarchy is a grouping by capability or architecture,such as data width,memory and peripheral integration;it is not a universal ranking in which every higher-bit chip is better.

Explanation,application and checks

  • By datapath width:8-bit,16-bit and32-bit families.An8-bit 8051 still has16-bit PC and DPTR;CPU data width does not require all registers to be8-bit.
  • By program memory:mask-ROM,OTP,EP ROM and Flash variants.By architecture:separate code/data spaces versus unified-space designs;by use:general-purpose and application-specific controllers.
  • Classic 8051 baseline:4KBprogram memory,128B RAM,32I/Opins,two timer/counters and UART.8052 and modern derivatives add/change resources;do not silently give their extra RAM/Timer2to the baseline.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Microcontroller hierarchy data width,memory/peripheral integration જેવી capability/architecture મુજબ grouping છે;higher-bit chip હંમેશાં વધુ સારી એવો universal rank નથી.

સમજણ,ઉપયોગ તથા ચકાસણી

  • Datapath મુજબ8-bit,16-bit/32-bit families.8-bit 8051માં પણ16-bit PC/DPTR છે;CPU data widthથી બધા registers8-bit હોવા જરૂરી નથી.
  • Program memory મુજબ mask-ROM,OTP,EP ROM/Flash;architecture મુજબ separate code/data તથા unified spaces;use મુજબ general-purpose/application-specific.
  • Classic 8051માં4KB program memory,128B RAM,32I/O pins,બે timer/counters/UART છે.8052/modern derivativeના extra RAM/Timer2ને baselineમાં નમાનો.

body.en:
Definition

An embedded control application senses inputs,executes a defined algorithm and controls outputs within the electrical,time and safety limits of a larger product.

Explanation,application and checks

  • Examples:metering,appliance sequencing,motor drive supervision,temperature indication,access alarms and solar tracking.Each requires suitable sensors,drivers,interfaces and protection,not a CPU alone.
  • Select memory,I/O,timing accuracy,ADC/UART requirements,operating temperature,power and support tools.The classic 8051 has no on-chip ADC;ADC0804 is an external conversion device.
  • Failure behaviour matters as much as normal operation:define reset outputs,timeout behaviour,watchdog strategy where supported and manual/emergency isolation.A classroom circuit is not an industrial safety controller.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Embedded control application inputs sense કરી algorithm ચલાવે અને મોટા productની electrical,time/safety limitsમાં outputs નિયંત્રિત કરે છે.

સમજણ,ઉપયોગ તથા ચકાસણી

  • Metering,appliance sequencing,motor supervision,temperature indication,alarm/solar tracking ઉદાહરણ છે.દરેકમાં sensors,drivers,interfaces/protection જોઈએ,માત્ર CPU નહીં.
  • Memory,I/O,timing accuracy,ADC/UART,temperature,power/support tools પસંદ કરો.Classic 8051માં on-chip ADC નથી;ADC0804 external converter છે.
  • Normal operation જેટલું failure behaviour મહત્વનું:reset outputs,timeout,supported watchdog/manual-emergency isolation નક્કી કરો.Classroom circuit industrial safety controller નથી.

body.en:
Definition

An embedded system is a hardware-software system designed to perform specified functions within a larger device,often subject to resource and timing constraints.

Explanation,application and checks

  • By service:standalone,networked,mobile and real-time systems.By scale:small,medium and complex designs,with boundaries chosen for the course rather than fixed universal chip counts.
  • Hard real-time:a missed deadline is unacceptable for the requirement;soft real-time:late results degrade service but may retain value.Real-time means meeting deadlines,not merely high clock speed.
  • Construction comprises sensors/input conditioning,controller memory/firmware,power/clock/reset,output drivers and user/communication interfaces.Working is repeated sense→validate→decide→act→monitor.
  • Polling is simple but may block;interrupt-driven designs respond to events while a main loop handles nonurgent work.No classification removes the need for electrical protection and fault handling.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Embedded system મોટા deviceમાં specified functions માટે રચાયેલી hardware-software system છે,જેમાં ઘણીવાર resources/timing constraints હોય છે.

સમજણ,ઉપયોગ તથા ચકાસણી

  • Service મુજબ standalone,networked,mobile/real-time;scale મુજબ small,medium/complex designs;આ boundaries course convention છે,fixed universal chip counts નહીં.
  • Hard real-timeમાં requirement મુજબ deadline ચૂકી નશકાય;soft real-timeમાં delayથી service ઘટે છતાં result ઉપયોગી હોઈ શકે.Real-time એટલે deadline પૂરી કરવી,માત્ર high clock નહીં.
  • Constructionમાં sensors/conditioning,controller-memory/firmware,power-clock-reset,drivers/user-communication interface છે.Working sense→validate→decide→act→monitor છે.
  • Polling સરળ છે પણ block થઈ શકે;interrupt events સંભાળે અને main loop nonurgent work કરે.કોઈ classification electrical protection/fault handlingની જરૂર દૂર કરતી નથી.

body.en:
Definition

The 8051 is an8-bit control-oriented CPU architecture with separate code and data address spaces,bit operations and integrated control peripherals.

Classification / principle

  • CPU/ALU and registers;code/data memory;I/O;timers;serial;interrupt;clock/reset are distinct functional groups.

Construction / registers / connections

  1. ALUoperates on8-bit operands,mainly with accumulator A;Bsupports MUL/DIVand can store temporary data.
  2. PC and instruction decoder fetch/decode opcodes;DPTR forms16-bit addresses for selected data/code accesses.
  3. RAM holds working data,register banks and stack;SFR sconfigure ports,flags,timers and UART.
  4. Ports connect logic-level signals;timers measure intervals/events and interrupt logic selects enabled requests.
  5. Oscillator generates timing and reset places core/SFR sinto a defined state;external load safety still needs hardware design.

Working / execution sequence

  1. PC identifies the next code byte;fetch reads the opcode from the selected internal/external code memory.
  2. Decoder determines operand sources,addressing mode and instruction length.
  3. Operands are read from registers,RAM,SFR sor immediate bytes using the permitted access form.
  4. ALU/data-transfer logic performs the operation and writes the destination;relevant flags change as specified.
  5. PC advances or changes for a branch/call/return;enabled interrupts can transfer control between instructions with the required return state preserved.

Explanation,application and checks

  • Classic code space can address up to64KBand external data space up to64KB;the4KBon-chip program size is not the same as total addressable code space.
  • Harvard-style separation describes logical spaces;external address/data pins can be multiplexed.An8-bit data bus does not imply an8-bit program address.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

8051 એ8-bit control-oriented CPU architecture છે,જેમાં separate code/data spaces,bit operations તથા integrated peripherals છે.

વર્ગીકરણ / સિદ્ધાંત

  • CPU/ALU-registers,code/data memory,I/O,timers,serial,interrupt તથા clock/reset અલગ groups છે.

Construction / Registers / જોડાણ

  1. ALU8-bit operands પર મુખ્યત્વે A સાથે કામ કરે;B MUL/DIV તથા temporary data માટે છે.
  2. PC/instruction decoder opcode fetch-decode કરે;DPTR selected data/code access માટે16-bit address આપે.
  3. RAM working data,register banks/stack રાખે;SFR ports,flags,timers/UART configure કરે.
  4. Ports logic-level signals જોડે;timers intervals/events માપે અને interrupt logic enabled requests પસંદ કરે.
  5. Oscillator timing આપે/reset defined state બનાવે;external load safety માટે હજી hardware design જોઈએ.

Working / અમલનો ક્રમ

  1. PC next code byte બતાવે;fetch selected internal/external code memoryમાંથી opcode વાંચે.
  2. Decoder operand source,addressing mode/instruction length નક્કી કરે.
  3. Permitted accessથી registers,RAM,SFR/immediate bytesમાંથી operands વાંચાય.
  4. ALU/data-transfer logic operation કરી destination લખે;specified flags બદલાય.
  5. PC advance થાય કે branch/call/returnથી બદલાય;enabled interrupt instructions વચ્ચે return state સાચવી control બદલે.

સમજણ,ઉપયોગ તથા ચકાસણી

  • Classic code space64KB તથા external data space64KB સુધી address કરે;on-chip4KB program size/total addressable code space અલગ છે.
  • Harvard-style separation logical spaces બતાવે;external address/data pins multiplex થાય.8-bit data bus એટલે8-bit program address નહીં.

body.en:
Definition

A flag is a status bit indicating a specified condition of an operation;carry represents unsigned carry/borrow while overflow represents signed-range overflow for relevant arithmetic instructions.

Explanation,application and checks

  • PSW bits7..0:CY,AC,F0,RS1,RS0,OV,reserved,P.RS1/RS0select the register bank;Pindicates odd parity of A.
  • FFH+01H→00Hwith CY=1;7FH+01H→80Hwith OV=1 and CY=0.These represent different unsigned/signed interpretations.
  • ACrecords carry from bit3to bit4in relevant operations;it supports decimal adjustment.INC/DECdo not set CYas a general carry/borrow indicator.SUBB subtracts both operand and incoming CY.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Flag operationની specified condition બતાવતો status bit છે;carry unsigned carry/borrow તથા overflow relevant arithmeticમાં signed-range overflow બતાવે.

સમજણ,ઉપયોગ તથા ચકાસણી

  • PSW bits7..0:CY,AC,F0,RS1,RS0,OV,reserved,P.RS1/RS0 register bank પસંદ કરે;P Aની odd parity બતાવે.
  • FFH+01H→00H સાથે CY=1;7FH+01H→80H સાથે OV=1/CY=0.આ unsigned/signed interpretationનો ભેદ છે.
  • Relevant operationમાં bit3થી bit4 carry ACમાં મળે;decimal adjustmentમાં ઉપયોગી છે.INC/DEC CYને general carry/borrow તરીકે સેટ નકરે.SUBB operand તથા incoming CY બંને બાદ કરે.

body.en:
Definition

PC is the16-bit program counter;DPTR is the16-bit data pointer formed by DPHand DPL;SP is the8-bit pointer to the current internal stack top.

Explanation,application and checks

  • PC changes through instruction sequencing and control transfer;it is not a normal directly addressable SFR.DPTR is used by MOVX and indexed MOVC,not automatically by every MOVinstruction.
  • DPL=82H,DPH=83H,SP=81Hare direct SFR addresses.A16-bit pointer can address more than256 bytes even though the ALUis8-bit.
  • For stack discipline,match PUSH/POPand CALL/RET;RETI is required for an interrupt return because it also informs interrupt control.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

PC 16-bit program counter છે;DPH/DPLથી બનેલું DPTR 16-bit data pointer છે;SP current internal stack topનો8-bit pointer છે.

સમજણ,ઉપયોગ તથા ચકાસણી

  • PC instruction sequence/control transferથી બદલાય;normal directly addressable SFR નથી.DPTR MOVX/indexed MOVCમાં વપરાય,દરેક MOVમાં આપમેળે નહીં.
  • DPL=82H,DPH=83H,SP=81H direct SFR addresses છે.ALU8-bit હોવા છતાં16-bit pointer256 bytes કરતાં વધુ address કરે.
  • Stack discipline માટે PUSH/POP તથા CALL/RET match કરો;interrupt return માટે RETI જોઈએ,કારણકે તે interrupt controlને પણ જાણ કરે.

title.en: 1.6 Internal RAM,bit area and register banks
title.gu: 1.6 Internal RAM,Bit area તથા Register banks

h.en: Internal RAM,bit area and register banks
h.gu: Internal RAM,Bit area તથા Register banks

body.en:
Definition

The baseline 8051 internal RAM is128 bytes at00H–7FH;it holds four register banks,a bit-addressable area and general working data/stack.

Explanation,application and checks

  • 00H–1FH:four banks of eight registers R0–R7;bank0=00H–07H,bank1=08H–0FH,bank2=10H–17H,bank3=18H–1FH.
  • 20H–2FHcontains16 bytes=128individually addressable bits;30H–7FHprovides80general RAM bytes if not allocated for other needs.Abit address is not a byte address.
  • RS1/RS0choose a bank without moving stored bytes.R0/R1may act as indirect pointers;R2–R7cannot replace them in classic MOV A,@Ri.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Baseline 8051 internal RAM 00H–7FH પર128 bytes છે;તેમાં ચાર register banks,bit-addressable area તથા general data/stack છે.

સમજણ,ઉપયોગ તથા ચકાસણી

  • 00H–1FHમાં ચાર R0–R7 banks છે;bank0=00H–07H,bank1=08H–0FH,bank2=10H–17H,bank3=18H–1FH.
  • 20H–2FHમાં16 bytes=128 individually addressable bits છે;30H–7FHમાં અન્ય allocation પહેલાં80general RAM bytes છે.Bit address/byte address અલગ છે.
  • RS1/RS0 stored bytes ખસેડ્યા વિના bank પસંદ કરે.R0/R1 indirect pointers બની શકે;classic MOV A,@Riમાં R2–R7 તેમને replace નકરી શકે.

body.en:
Definition

Program memory stores instructions/constants;SFR sare control/status registers reached by direct addressing in the80H–FFHrange,not the upper half of baseline RAM.

Explanation,application and checks

  • Original 8051 has4KBmask ROM;AT89C51 has4KBFlash.Derivative memory size and erase/program method must be checked from its datasheet.
  • MOVaccesses internal data/SFR forms;MOVX accesses external data space;MOVC reads constants in code space.Code and data addresses of the same numeric value need not refer to the same storage.
  • Direct address90His P1;indirect@R0 with R0=90Hdoes not read P1.On a baseline 8051 that upper indirect RAM is not implemented;on 8052 derivatives it may address separate added RAM.
  • Only implemented SFR addresses/bits are valid;do not assume every address in80H–FFHis a usable register.P0=80H,P1=90H,P2=A0H,P3=B0H,IE=A8H,PSW=D0H.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Program memory instructions/constants રાખે;SFR 80H–FFH rangeમાં direct addressingથી મળતા control/status registers છે,baseline RAMનો upper half નહીં.

સમજણ,ઉપયોગ તથા ચકાસણી

  • Original 8051માં4KB mask ROM,AT89C51માં4KB Flash છે.Derivative size તથા erase/program method datasheetથી તપાસો.
  • MOV internal data/SFR forms,MOVX external data અને MOVC code constants વાંચે.Same numeric code/data address એક જ storage હોય એવું નથી.
  • Direct90H P1 છે;R0=90H સાથે indirect@R0 P1 નથી વાંચતું.Baseline 8051માં upper indirect RAM નથી;8052 derivativeમાં separate added RAM હોઈ શકે.
  • Implemented SFR addresses/bits જ valid છે;80H–FFHના બધા addresses usable નથી.P0=80H,P1=90H,P2=A0H,P3=B0H,IE=A8H,PSW=D0H.

body.en:
Definition

A stack is a last-in-first-out storage area used for saved data and return addresses;the classic 8051 hardware stack resides in internal data RAM and grows upward.

Explanation,application and checks

  • Reset SP=07H;PUSHfirst increments SP then stores,so first byte is at08H.POPreads current SP then decrements.This default overlaps bank1 and may collide with compiler allocations.
  • If approved assembly allocates stack above2FH,SP=2FHmakes the first push use30H.This is an example allocation,not a universal safe setting for every Cprogram.
  • CALLand interrupt entry save return address bytes;ISR and compiler-generated code can save more data.Plan worst-case nesting,local storage and stack depth with the linker map;never overwrite compiler SP setup casually.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Stack saved data/return addresses માટે last-in-first-out storage છે;classic 8051 hardware stack internal data RAMમાં હોય અને ઉપરના address તરફ વધે.

સમજણ,ઉપયોગ તથા ચકાસણી

  • Reset SP=07H;PUSH પહેલાં SP વધારે પછી store કરે,એટલે first byte08H.POP current SP વાંચી પછી ઘટાડે.Default bank1/compiler allocations સાથે collide થઈ શકે.
  • Approved assemblyમાં stack2FH ઉપર allocate થાય તો SP=2FHથી first push30H વાપરે.આ example છે,દરેક C program માટે universal safe setting નહીં.
  • CALL/interrupt entry return-address bytes save કરે;ISR/compiler code વધુ data save કરી શકે.Linker mapથી nesting/local storage/stack depth જુઓ;compiler SP setup મનસ્વી નબદલો.

body.en:
Definition

A pin function specifies the electrical role of a package terminal;an alternate function shares that terminal with another peripheral and must not be assigned conflicting uses simultaneously.

Explanation,application and checks

  • For the40pinD IP:VCC 40,GND 20,RST9,XTAL1=19,XTAL2=18;EA31,ALE30,PSEN29.P1 pins1–8,P3 pins10–17,P2 pins21–28,P0 pins39–32.
  • P3.0RXD,P3.1TXD,P3.2 INT0,P3.3 INT1,P3.4T0,P3.5T1,P3.6 WR,P3.7 RD.External memory uses P0 multiplexed AD0–AD7 and P2 high address A8–A15.
  • EAselects internal/external program access according to the chip memory arrangement;PSENstrobes external code reads and ALElatches the low address.These are not general-purpose spare pins.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Pin function package terminalનો electrical role છે;alternate function એ terminal બીજા peripheral સાથે share કરે,એટલે conflicting uses એકસાથે નઆપવા.

સમજણ,ઉપયોગ તથા ચકાસણી

  • 40pin D IPમાં VCC 40,GND 20,RST9,XTAL1=19,XTAL2=18;EA31,ALE30,PSEN29.P1 pins1–8,P3 pins10–17,P2 pins21–28,P0 pins39–32.
  • P3.0RXD,P3.1TXD,P3.2 INT0,P3.3 INT1,P3.4T0,P3.5T1,P3.6 WR,P3.7 RD.External memoryમાં P0 multiplexed AD0–AD7 તથા P2 high address A8–A15 છે.
  • EA chip memory arrangement મુજબ internal/external program access પસંદ કરે;PSEN external code read strobe તથા ALE low address latch માટે છે.આ general spare pins નથી.

h.en: I/Oports:release inputs and drive loads safely
h.gu: I/O ports:Inputs release તથા Safe load driving

body.en:
Definition

A quasi-bidirectional port uses its latch and pullup structure for input/output operation;writing1releases a pin for external input,while writing0actively drives low.

Explanation,application and checks

  • P1/P2/P3 have internal pullups;P0 GPIO is open drain and needs external pullups to produce a defined HIGH.Aread-modify-write instruction may read the latch instead of the pin;use bit operations/port shadows deliberately.
  • Release a switch input before reading it;an active-low switch connects to ground under the approved trainer arrangement.Debounce prevents one press being counted many times.
  • Pin current,port total and device total all matter.Use resistors and compatible buffers/transistor drivers;do not power relay coils,DCmotors,stepper coils or large LED arrays directly from the MCU.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Quasi-bidirectional port latch/pullupથી input-output કરે;1 લખતાં external input માટે release થાય,0 લખતાં actively low drive થાય.

સમજણ,ઉપયોગ તથા ચકાસણી

  • P1/P2/P3માં internal pullups છે;P0 GPIO open-drain હોવાથી defined HIGH માટે external pullups જોઈએ.Read-modify-write latch વાંચી શકે;bit operations/port shadow સમજી વાપરો.
  • Switch input વાંચતાં પહેલાં release કરો;approved trainerમાં active-low switch ground તરફ જોડાય.Debounce એક pressને અનેક events થવાથી રોકે.
  • Pin current,port/device total બધાં limits જરૂરી.Resistors/compatible buffers-drivers લો;relay,DC motor,stepper કે large LED array સીધી MCUથી નચલાવો.

body.en:
Definition

Clocking supplies the timing reference for instruction/peripheral operation;reset establishes defined initial core/register states when its specified level and duration are satisfied.

Assumptions,ordered derivation and checks

  1. Classic12Tmachine cycle Tmc=12/fosc.At12MHz,Tmc=1µs;at11.0592MHz,Tmc≈1.085069µs.Modern1T/6Tderivatives require their own timing model.
  2. Baseline active-HIGH RSTmust remain high for at least2machine cycles while the oscillator runs:treset≥2×12/fosc=24/fosc.At12MHzthis minimum is2µs;oscillator startup/power-ramp margin must also be provided.
  3. Crystal/load capacitors follow the specific oscillator/load specification;do not use a random universal capacitor value.Areset supervisor is more dependable than assuming an RC network handles every brownout.
  4. Check regulated supply,decoupling,ground,EA,reset waveform and oscillator before blaming firmware;programming method must match the exact chip,not just the 8051 family name.

વ્યાખ્યા

Clocking instruction/peripheral timing આપે;specified level/duration પૂરી થાય ત્યારે reset defined initial core/register states બનાવે.

ધારણાઓ,ક્રમબદ્ધ Derivation તથા ચકાસણી

  1. Classic12T માટે Tmc=12/fosc.12MHz પર1µs;11.0592MHz પર≈1.085069µs.Modern1T/6T માટે અલગ model જોઈએ.
  2. Active-HIGH RST oscillator ચાલતો હોય ત્યારે ઓછામાં ઓછા2machine cycles high રહે:treset≥2×12/fosc=24/fosc.12MHz પર minimum2µs છે;startup/power-ramp margin પણ જોઈએ.
  3. Crystal/load capacitors oscillator/load specification મુજબ પસંદ કરો;random universal value નહીં.RC બધા brownouts સંભાળે એમ માનવા કરતાં reset supervisor વધુ dependable છે.
  4. Firmwareને દોષ આપતાં પહેલાં supply,decoupling,ground,EA,reset/oscillator તપાસો.Programming method exact chip મુજબ હોય,માત્ર8051 family nameથી નહીં.

body.en:
Aim and status

A source-suggested learning/report plan,not an already completed workshop,visit or project.

  • Prepare verified 8051,ADC0804,LM35,CD4051,L293D,MAX232 and selected GSM module sheets;state package,supply,input range,pin functions,logic levels and source revision.

TI ADC0804-N:input/reference/clock/conversion timing

TIL293/L293D:logic/load supply and current/clamps

TI CD4051 B:analog switch limits

Keil interrupt function/vector rules

  • Simulator/watchમાં P0,low_byte/borrow જુઓ;physical P0 HIGH માટે external pullups જોઈએ.
  • 10−25થી low_byte=F1H,borrow=1;આ modulo8-bit−15 છે,signed positive241 જવાબ નહીં.
  • Resources:exact 8051 trainer/target simulator,correct programmer/headers,isolated current-limited supply તથા required approved instruments/components;power પહેલાં datasheet/reset-safe gating તપાસો.
  • Procedure:target/clock ઓળખો→power OFF pin map review→build/warnings→simulator load→logic/watch check→teacher approvalથી isolated trainer test→actual evidence/safe power down.
  • Fault findingમાં supply/clock/reset/EA,port release/polarity,pin conflict,ground/reference,driver enable/software assumptions ક્રમથી તપાસો.Live rewiring/random supply change નહીં.
  • ઉપર expected values calculated/reference behaviour છે,recorded observations નહીં.Genuine work પહેલાં actual results,status,signatures/waveforms blank રાખો.
